name: Beech Leaf Coaster
finished_size: About 12 cm long including stem; about 7 cm wide

yarn.description: Cotton yarn for the leaf, stem and raised vein

gauge: Gauge is not critical. Use a firm tension so the coaster lies flat and provides a stable surface for a mug or glass.

steps.text: Ch 16. Working in the back bump of the foundation chain, sc in second ch from hook, hdc in next 2 ch, dc in next 9 ch, hdc in next 2 ch, sc in last ch; ch 2, sc in same last ch. Do not turn. Rotate the work to crochet along the opposite side of the foundation chain: hdc in next 2 ch, dc in next 9 ch, hdc in next 2 ch, sc in last ch.
With the active loop at the leaf base, ch 7. Sl st in second ch from hook and in each of the next 5 ch, ending at the leaf base to form the compact stem.
Make a surface sl st through each of the 15 centre-chain loops, working from the leaf base to the tip, to form the raised central vein.

finishing: Fasten off at the leaf tip after completing the surface vein, leaving a 10 cm tail.
Weave in the starting and fastening-off tails on the reverse side without pulling the leaf out of shape.
Dampen the coaster lightly, smooth the pointed tip and curved sides, then leave it flat to dry completely.
notes: For a surface sl st, insert the hook from front to back through a centre-chain loop, yarn over beneath the fabric, then pull the yarn through the fabric and active loop.
